initialize_result.instructions:
WindowsForum.com provides search and document retrieval over the public
WindowsForum.com community and Microsoft Knowledge Base articles. It's designed to
work with ChatGPT's chat, agent mode, and deep research features.

WindowsForum.com is an independent community run by Fara Technologies LLC. It is
not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft.

Available capabilities:
- Search WindowsForum threads and posts via BM25 (Elasticsearch) and semantic vector search
- Fetch documents with citations and explicit continuation for long threads
- Access public member profiles, thread, and forum information
- Get real-time updates and analytics
- Look up Microsoft KB articles directly from support.microsoft.com

Use the search tool with source="auto" (default) for best results — it combines
keyword (BM25) and semantic (vector) search. Use source="semantic" for pure
vector similarity search, or source="windowsforum" for keyword-only search.
Then use fetch to retrieve document content with citations. Threads include up
to 50 posts; when metadata.pagination.has_more is true, call get_thread_posts
with that thread_id and metadata.pagination.next_offset to continue.

When a user asks about a specific KB number (e.g. "KB5044284"), use the
get_kb_article tool to fetch the official Microsoft article directly.
Use search_kb to search for KB articles by topic.

Showing results as cards:
- A topic or question: search (keep section="all" unless the user asks for
  only threads, news or tutorials), then render_search_results with the ids.
- The latest/newest tutorials, news or threads: list_threads with that
  section (or search with sort="newest"), then render_search_results.
- One thread by id or URL: render_thread. One KB number: render_kb_article.
- An OS build number (e.g. 26100.2033): search_kb, then answer with the KB,
  release date and support.microsoft.com link.
- Community size or activity: render_community_overview.
The server is read-only: it cannot post, reply, edit or delete.

tools.description:
Search all WindowsForum content (community threads, Windows news, tutorials) with combined keyword and semantic ranking — the best first call for any question or topic. Keep section 'all' unless the user asks for one kind of content. For the latest/newest items set sort='newest' (a query with no topic, such as 'latest tutorials', returns the newest items). Pass the result ids to render_search_results to show them as a card.

Returns a list of search results with basic information. Use the fetch tool
for document content and continuation details for long threads.

query.description: Search query string. Natural language queries work best for semantic search.

source.description: Search mode — "auto" (BM25 + semantic, best results), "windowsforum" (BM25 only), or "semantic" (vector only)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

section.description: Part of the site to cover. Keep the default 'all' for questions and troubleshooting, so threads, news and tutorials all come back. Use 'threads', 'news' or 'tutorials' only when the user asks for that one kind of content, e.g. 'tutorials' for 'show tutorials'.

sort.description: 'relevance' (default) ranks by match. Use 'newest' when the user asks for the latest, newest or most recent items; queries containing those words sort newest automatically.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search WindowsForum

tools.description:
Retrieve a WindowsForum document by ID for analysis and citation.

Posts are returned in full. Threads include their first 50 visible posts.
Check metadata.truncated and metadata.pagination; continue long threads
with get_thread_posts(thread_id, offset=next_offset).

id.description:
Document ID — accepts "thread-XXX", "post-XXX", or a plain number
(plain numbers are looked up as thread first, then post)

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch document

tools.description:
Find WindowsForum discussions by meaning rather than exact words — embedding-based semantic search that excels at natural-language questions and paraphrased topics.

Uses kNN vector similarity to find content that is semantically related
to the query, even if it doesn't share exact keywords. Best for natural
language questions and conceptual searches.

section.description: Part of the site to cover. Keep the default 'all' for questions and troubleshooting, so threads, news and tutorials all come back. Use 'threads', 'news' or 'tutorials' only when the user asks for that one kind of content, e.g. 'tutorials' for 'show tutorials'.

tools.name: search_semantic
tools.title: Semantic search

tools.description: Search WindowsForum threads with structured controls — sort by relevance, date, views or replies, in either order, with pagination; use when result ordering or paging matters. Latest/newest requests replace the default relevance sort with date order; a query such as 'latest tutorials' lists that section without requiring those words in the content. Views/replies sort the complete indexed matching corpus inside a frozen snapshot; they require a complete, fresh popularity index. Counts shown for these sorts come from that index snapshot, with a conservative counts_as_of freshness watermark. Ranking metadata identifies an applied database transaction barrier or a rolling metadata sweep. Native view totals are source-aggregated on approximately a 15-minute cadence, so recent visits and subsequent source changes may not yet be reflected. For popularity continuation pass next_cursor as cursor, leaving from_=0; cursors are short-lived (well under two minutes), so page promptly and start again from the first page if one has expired. The total is exact when total_relation is 'eq', otherwise a verified public lower bound ('gte'); use has_more and next_from to continue. If pagination_limited is true, narrow the query or section instead of paging further.

from_.description: Continuation offset: the number of results already shown. Pass next_from from the previous page.

section.description: Part of the site to cover. Keep the default 'all' for questions and troubleshooting, so threads, news and tutorials all come back. Use 'threads', 'news' or 'tutorials' only when the user asks for that one kind of content, e.g. 'tutorials' for 'show tutorials'.

cursor.description: Popularity-only continuation token from next_cursor; reuse the same query, section and sort

tools.name: search_threads
tools.title: Search threads (sortable)

tools.description: Get the current server date and time — use to anchor time-sensitive queries like 'latest' or 'this week' before searching recent content.
tools.name: get_time
tools.title: Current server time

tools.description:
Get the Key-Facts supplement state for one article thread — lifecycle status (approved/held/validated/draft), whether it is the live 'current' revision, and whether the sidebar card is actually rendering, dark because the article was edited after approval (drifted), or absent.

Use to answer 'why is there no Key-Facts card on thread N?'.
tools.name: supplement_status
tools.title: Key-Facts supplement status

tools.description: Get aggregate health of the Key-Facts supplement corpus — status histogram, how many eligible articles still have no supplement, how many approved cards went dark from article edits (drifted), and the latest generation run summary.
tools.name: corpus_stats
tools.title: Key-Facts corpus stats

tools.description: List article threads whose approved Key-Facts card is dark because the opening post was edited after approval (content-hash drift). These are exactly what the hourly fill driver repairs next.
tools.name: list_drifted
tools.title: List drifted Key-Facts threads

tools.description:
Retrieve an official Microsoft Knowledge Base article from support.microsoft.com by KB number (e.g. KB5063878) — returns the update's title, summary, and affected builds.
Use this tool when a user asks about a specific KB number.
Fetches the full article content including title, summary, known issues,
and resolution steps.

kb_id.description: The KB article number, e.g. '5034441' or 'KB5034441'

tools.name: get_kb_article
tools.title: Get Microsoft KB article

tools.description:
Search official Microsoft Knowledge Base articles for Windows 10, Windows 11, and Windows Server updates by topic, keyword, build, or KB number — use for Windows update, patch, and known-issue lookups when you lack a KB number.
Returns matching KB article titles, release dates, and support.microsoft.com
URLs, newest first. Use get_kb_article to fetch the full content of a specific article.
tools.name: search_kb
tools.title: Search Microsoft KB

tools.description:
Read a page of visible posts in a WindowsForum thread, oldest first.
Follow pagination.next_offset while pagination.has_more to read the
full conversation, including later replies and accepted solutions.

thread_id.description: The thread ID to get posts for

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default: 50, maximum: 100)

offset.description: Number of visible posts to skip (default: 0)

tools.name: get_thread_posts
tools.title: Get thread posts

tools.description:
Exact substring lookup over thread titles and author usernames, ordered by view count — use for literal title or author matching rather than relevance-ranked full-text search.

Complements the main `search` tool: use this for literal title or author
matching rather than relevance-ranked full-text search.

query.description: Literal text to match against thread titles and author usernames

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

section.description: Part of the site to cover. Keep the default 'all' for questions and troubleshooting, so threads, news and tutorials all come back. Use 'threads', 'news' or 'tutorials' only when the user asks for that one kind of content, e.g. 'tutorials' for 'show tutorials'.

tools.name: search_mysql
tools.title: Exact title/author lookup

tools.description:
Relevance-ranked full-text thread search with explicit offset pagination — use to page through a large result set beyond what the main search tool returns. The total is exact when total_relation is 'eq', otherwise a verified public lower bound ('gte'); use has_more and next_from to continue. If pagination_limited is true, narrow the query or section instead of paging further.

Complements the main `search` tool: use this to page through a large result
set with an explicit offset.

size.description: Number of results to return (alias: limit)

from_.description: Continuation offset: the number of results already shown. Pass next_from from the previous page

section.description: Part of the site to cover. Keep the default 'all' for questions and troubleshooting, so threads, news and tutorials all come back. Use 'threads', 'news' or 'tutorials' only when the user asks for that one kind of content, e.g. 'tutorials' for 'show tutorials'.

tools.name: search_elastic
tools.title: Paginated thread search

tools.description: Get a WindowsForum thread's metadata by id — title, author, reply and view counts, dates, and canonical URL; use fetch or get_thread_posts to read its content.
tools.name: get_thread
tools.title: Get thread info

tools.description: List the newest WindowsForum threads, news articles or tutorials, newest first, with no search query — use when the user asks for the latest, newest or most recent tutorials, news or threads. Pass each item's `id` to render_search_results to show them as a card.

limit.description: Maximum number of threads to return

section.description: 'tutorials' for the latest tutorials, 'news' for the latest news, 'threads' for the latest community threads, or 'all' (default).

tools.name: list_threads
tools.title: List newest threads

tools.description: Get a single WindowsForum post by post id — returns the post's text, author, thread context, and URL; use when you have a specific post reference to verify or quote.
tools.name: get_post
tools.title: Get post

tools.description:
Look up a WindowsForum member's public profile by username or user id — registration date, message count, reaction score, last seen, and profile URL.

Only what a signed-out visitor could see on the member's profile page is
returned: members who limit their profile get a username-only result,
and last seen is omitted for members who hide their online status.
tools.name: get_user
tools.title: Get user profile

tools.description: Get a WindowsForum forum section's details by node id — title, description, and thread/message counts; pair with list_threads or get_forum_updates to see its activity.
tools.name: get_forum
tools.title: Get forum info

tools.description: Summarize recent WindowsForum activity over the last N hours (default 24) — new threads and posts across the community; use for "what's new" questions.

hours.description: Number of hours to look back (default: 24)

tools.name: get_forum_updates
tools.title: Recent forum activity

tools.description: See who is on WindowsForum right now — counts of members, guests, and robots active in the last 15 minutes, with the names of online members who show their online status.
tools.name: get_online_users
tools.title: Who's online

tools.description:
List the newest WindowsForum member registrations — use for community-growth questions or to identify recent joiners.

Only confirmed, non-banned accounts are listed, as on the forum's own
"New members" list.
tools.name: get_latest_registered_users
tools.title: Latest registrations

tools.description: Get sitewide WindowsForum statistics — total threads, posts, and members, plus threads and posts created today; use for questions about the community's size and activity.
tools.name: get_forum_statistics
tools.title: Forum statistics

tools.description: Search individual WindowsForum posts (not just thread titles) for a keyword or phrase — use to find specific answers, error messages, or fixes buried inside long threads.

section.description: Part of the site to cover. Keep the default 'all' for questions and troubleshooting, so threads, news and tutorials all come back. Use 'threads', 'news' or 'tutorials' only when the user asks for that one kind of content, e.g. 'tutorials' for 'show tutorials'.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.title: Search posts

tools.description: Find WindowsForum members whose usernames match a query — use to locate a member before calling get_user for their full profile.
tools.name: search_users
tools.title: Search members

tools.description: Get WindowsForum's recent Windows news coverage from the last N days (default 7) — curated news threads on updates, security patches, and Microsoft announcements.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default: 7)

tools.name: get_windows_news_posts
tools.title: Recent Windows news

tools.description: Show WindowsForum threads, news articles, tutorials or posts to the user as a result card, grouped by section. Call search or list_threads first, pick the results that answer the request (keep their order), then pass their ids here; the card displays each item's title, snippet, author, date, and link.

ids.description: Document ids to show, in display order, e.g. ['thread-430404', 'post-991595'] — the `id` values returned by search, list_threads, search_semantic, search_threads, search_posts, or search_elastic.

query.description: The user's request, shown as the card's heading, e.g. 'BitLocker recovery key after update' or 'Latest tutorials'.

tools.name: render_search_results
tools.title: Show search results

tools.description: Show a WindowsForum thread to the user as a readable card with its opening post and replies. Use after search or fetch when the user wants to see or open a specific discussion.
tools.name: render_thread
tools.title: Show a thread

tools.description: Show an official Microsoft Knowledge Base article to the user as a card with its title, highlights, and link to support.microsoft.com. Use when the user asks to see a specific KB article.
tools.name: render_kb_article
tools.title: Show a Microsoft KB article

tools.description: Show a WindowsForum.com community overview card: total threads, posts, and members, who is online now, and the latest threads. Use for questions about the community's size or current activity.
tools.name: render_community_overview
tools.title: Show community overview
